about: (Noah: one longer Easter egg for each class, and the wonders harder to win) one hidden quest per class, opened once 6 cities are freed and never explained in game; finishing it is the only way to win the class's wonder. Each step is played at a freed city's Echo Altar, and never in the same city as the step before (the altar's menu shows its whispers - each step's hint, a line more for each step found). Steps: touch (find n glowing things round the altar, element in hand if asked, at night if night, without being hurt if nodamage, within seconds if set), order (touch n stones in the order they light), altar (return to an altar), kills (n of the night's dead on marked ground), classkills (n of the night's dead killed your class's way in that city at night), survive (n of the dead risen round the altar; dark: the screen darkens), boss (a named foe: an enemies row).

rows.title: The Wyrm's Calling
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Horn of the Spectral Wyrm waits on its pedestal in the Reliquary.

steps.text: Find the four wyrm-bone shards buried round an Echo Altar at night
steps.name: wyrm-bone shard
steps.hint: Bones of a wyrm lie shallow round the altars. They wake only in the dark.

steps.text: Feed the bones: 30 of the dead slain by your summons, in another freed city at night
steps.hint: What you call must do the killing. The bones drink only what your servants kill.

steps.text: Wake the four bone-totems in the order they glow
steps.name: bone-totem
steps.hint: The totems remember the order they were raised. Watch them.

steps.text: Lay the bones on an Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar
steps.hint: The bones want an altar's fire.

steps.text: Hold the altar in the dark while the wyrm's soul stirs
steps.hint: When the wyrm stirs, the light goes out. Hold.

steps.text: Catch the five spirit-flames before they gutter out
steps.name: spirit-flame
steps.hint: Five flames, and not long to catch them.

steps.text: Destroy the Bone-Caller, who would bind the wyrm before you
steps.name: The Bone-Caller
steps.hint: Someone else is calling the wyrm.

rows.title: The Six Fires
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Tome of the Six Fires waits on its pedestal in the Reliquary.

steps.text: Burn open the three ember-seals round an Echo Altar (fire in hand)
steps.name: ember-seal
steps.hint: Three seals sleep in the ashes. Only flame will open them.

steps.text: Shatter the three rime-seals in another freed city (frost in hand)
steps.name: rime-seal
steps.hint: The next seals are ice. Cold breaks cold.

steps.text: Wake the three storm-seals in another freed city (lightning in hand)
steps.name: storm-seal
steps.hint: The last seals hum. Give them lightning.

steps.text: Kindle the tome: 40 of the dead slain with Destruction, in another freed city at night
steps.hint: The tome is kindled with the dead your spells burn.

steps.text: Turn the four light-stones in the order they shine
steps.name: light-stone
steps.hint: Four stones shine in turn. Turn them as they show you.

steps.text: Gather the four drifting anomalies without being hurt
steps.name: anomaly
steps.hint: The anomalies scatter from a bleeding hand.

steps.text: Unmake the Great Anomaly
steps.name: The Great Anomaly
steps.hint: All that magic drew something. It waits.

rows.title: The Vortex's Eye
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: the Subsuming Vortex waits on its pedestal in the Reliquary.

steps.text: Catch the five falling stars round an Echo Altar before they fade
steps.name: falling star
steps.hint: Stars fall near the altars at night - five, and they fade fast.

steps.text: Feed the dark: 40 of the dead slain with a bow or crossbow, in another freed city at night
steps.hint: Only the string feeds it.

steps.text: Take the three shadow coins without being hurt
steps.name: shadow coin
steps.hint: Three coins in the shadows. Bleed and they slip away.

steps.text: Pay the coins to an Echo Altar
steps.name: the altar
steps.hint: Coins are for paying. The altar is owed.

steps.text: Light the four braziers in the order they flicker
steps.name: brazier
steps.hint: The braziers flicker in an order. Light them in it.

steps.text: Hold the altar in the dark
steps.hint: The dark comes for whoever holds the eye.

steps.text: Bring down the Matriarch of the Black Sky
steps.name: The Matriarch of the Black Sky
steps.hint: Something winged circles above the altars. Look up.

rows.title: The Slayer's Oath
rows.rewardText: The Greybeards call you to High Hrothgar: Dragon Slayer waits on its pedestal in the Reliquary.

steps.text: Feed the hallowed ground: 30 of the dead slain on it, near an Echo Altar at night
steps.name: the marked ground
steps.hint: A patch of ground near the altar is hungry. Feed it the dead.

steps.text: Blood the oath: 40 of the dead slain in melee, in another freed city at night
steps.hint: The oath is sworn with a blade, not a spell.

steps.text: Find the five broken blade-shards
steps.name: blade-shard
steps.hint: The old blade lies broken in five pieces, scattered by night.

steps.text: Strike the four rune-stones in the order they sing
steps.name: rune-stone
steps.hint: Four stones sing in turn. Strike them as they sing.

steps.text: Keep your oath: survive the dead risen round the altar
steps.hint: An oath is proven by standing.

steps.text: Take the blade's hilt from Thorgar the Skulltaker
steps.name: Thorgar the Skulltaker
steps.hint: A skull-taker carries what is missing.

steps.text: Defeat the Gatekeeper, the blade's last guardian
steps.name: The Gatekeeper
steps.hint: Every blade has a keeper. This one guards a gate.
